items.title: Frank Tiberi interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 30, 2022
items.q: the post on his horn broke, on the baritone, he couldn’t play. And one of the players said, “Frank is coming in” because he knew me you know he played with our band and he said, “When he comes in he’ll fix it.” I did.

ctx.x: And of course he called me “Cheech.” And if he called you by your nickname then he liked you. I mean there were a lot of players with me: Kenny Burrell, Ruby Braff, Doc Severinsen. And of course we went on the road with Urbie Green. These were some of the things actually. But another thing actually was I was a good repairman too. Benny Carter, every time we did the Norwegian he would always call me into his room and I had to change a pad you know. And this happened twice. And oh Gerry Mulligan had a gig of a…
That’s a great way to be in good with other musicians. Save their horns.
